decision_scope: Adopt iniconfig and its patch grader as a supplementary constructed workload for bounded investigations on the tested Codex and Copilot profiles. Retain migration-linter as a baseline-calibration limiting case. Both installed-CLI investigations reached fresh preservation confirmation; this establishes neither ordinary-workflow usefulness nor a general benchmark.

conditions.provider_model_comparability: Different routes/models; no harness or model comparison. Private profile identities are retained separately.
conditions.source_generation: Native ACK and repair turns; reference material and fixed verifiers excluded from model input.
conditions.calibration: Three fresh valid passing repairs required; no source response reuse credit.
conditions.controls: One exploratory observation per prescribed removal or changed-defect replay; separate from both normal-CLI investigations and their independent fresh confirmations.
conditions.patch_grading: Existing allowlisted regular-file content only; source and separately authored verifier suites. Candidate code shares the verifier interpreter and can alter assertions or reports; grades assume cooperative repairs. Grader/application revisions remain separate.

initial.fixed_trigger: Diagnose the reported behavior and return a unified diff that repairs it. Preserve the documented behavior and existing tests. Work from the supplied snapshots; do not call tools. Return only the diff.

existing_files.fixed_trigger: Diagnose the reported behavior and return a unified diff that repairs it. Preserve the documented behavior and existing tests. Work from the supplied snapshots; do not call tools. Return one applicable unified diff with correct hunk counts. Modify only existing files shown in the snapshots. Do not create, delete or rename files.

coarse_screen.candidate_scope: Grouped removal including the task field; nonmatches do not isolate either record.

normal_cli_investigation.developer_conclusion: The task field remained after the tested grouped-removal comparison. Its overload-declaration sections could be removed while freshly generated repairs passed all 42 source and eight independent checks within the declared valid-outcome preservation margin. Retained incident/source evidence is a sufficient tested input; the result establishes neither minimality nor the unique evidence used by the model.
normal_cli_investigation.retained_inspection: Normal installed CLI succeeded with network denied, zero provider requests and no text disclosure.

unknowns: Complete preparation/authoring effort and all provider-free control invocation costs were not measured.
Recorded token usage has varying coverage and provider-specific cache semantics; no combined token or monetary estimate.
Native authentication/catalogue/metadata traffic outside inference enforcement is not a complete network-traffic count.

limitations: Selected constructed tasks, not ordinary-workflow prevalence or a population success rate.
Separate confirmations cover one section-removal edit in each tested native profile at margin 0.20; neither coarse sweep completed. These are not joint or campaign-wide confidence claims.
Single control observations show task outcomes under these inputs, not statistical context dependence.
A rejected patch does not establish that its intended diagnosis is wrong.
Public task contamination and opaque captured native state are not causally excluded.
Native traces, credentials, responses and exact private profiles are not distributed; the public package reproduces fixture checks, not retained paid responses.
next_decision: Use iniconfig as a supplementary constructed evaluation workload; preserve migration-linter as a limiting outcome. Broader tasks, changed profiles, additional harnesses and ordinary-workflow qualification need separate evidence and execution approval.
maintenance: Review pinned task source, dependency versions and licenses when updating the package.
Replay correct alternatives and negative grading fixtures after source, verifier or grader changes.
Bind current runtime, native input and safety policy before new execution; changed profiles need their own qualification.
separate_work: Broader task/corpus selection requires a separately reviewed study.
Additional harnesses require their own adapters, reconstruction, isolation and qualification.
Ordinary-workflow usefulness remains a separate evidence requirement; preserve the unchanged issue16 limiting outcome.
